method: Unblinded supervising-agent inspection of every recorded tool input and source change, including byte-identical references to prior fully reviewed evidence. Raw lifecycle coverage checked independently. Bounded recorded-action audit, not a certificate of unrecorded behavior. No source repair or solution recovery.
endpoint: Registered instruction criteria AND successful runtime completion, with original official/functional/build/admission/termination results and known criterion conventions kept separate.
